title: Common finite normal refinement of rational field levels
statement: Let ι be a finite type and F : ι → IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ). Suppose every F i is finite-dimensional over ℚ. There exists an intermediate field E, finite-dimensional and normal over ℚ, containing every F i, whose pointwise fixing subgroup in Aut(AlgebraicClosure ℚ/ℚ) is normal and has finite index. The family may be empty.
lean_statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (F : ι → IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)), (∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℚ (F i)) → ∃ E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), FiniteDimensional ℚ E ∧ Normal ℚ E ∧ (∀ i, F i ≤ E) ∧ E.fixingSubgroup.Normal ∧ E.fixingSubgroup.FiniteIndex
